```
module naming.initials
  purpose: Derive initials from full names.

public function initials(name: Text)
  returns Text
  purpose: Return the upper-cased first letters of each word in a name, with nothing between them.
  tags: text, names
  example: initials("ada marie lovelace") is "AML"
  example: initials("  grace   hopper ") is "GH"
  example: initials("alan") is "A"
  example: initials("   ") is ""

  let letters be
    for each part in name.split(" ")
    where not part.is_empty()
    collect part.take(1).to_upper()
  return letters.join("")
end

test "initials of a full name"
  check initials("ada marie lovelace") is "AML"
end

test "extra spaces are ignored"
  check initials("  grace   hopper ") is "GH"
end

test "a blank name has no initials"
  check initials("   ") is ""
end
```

```
module names.initials
  purpose: Work out the initials of a person's full name.

public function initials_of(name: Text)
  returns Text
  purpose: Return the upper-cased first letters of each word in a full name, joined with nothing, ignoring blank or extra spaces.
  tags: text, names

  example: initials_of("  grace   hopper ") is "GH"
  example: initials_of("alan") is "A"
  example: initials_of("   ") is ""

  let words be name.split(" ")
  let letters be
    for each word in words
    where not word.is_empty()
    collect word.take(1).to_upper()
  return letters.join("")
end

test "initials ignore extra spaces"
  check initials_of("  ada   marie lovelace ") is "AML"
end
```

```
module text.initials
  purpose: Compute the initials of a full name.

public function initials(name: Text)
  returns Text
  purpose: Return the upper-cased first letters of each word in a name, joined with nothing between them, ignoring blank or extra spaces.
  tags: text, names
  example: initials("ada marie lovelace") is "AML"
  example: initials("  grace   hopper ") is "GH"
  example: initials("alan") is "A"
  example: initials("   ") is ""

  let letters be
    for each part in name.split(" ")
    where part is not ""
    collect part.take(1).to_upper()
  return letters.join("")
end
```
